info.title: Retainer — an x402-gated resource whose access renews itself
info.summary: Pay once. The Hedera Schedule Service keeps the access window open.
info.description:
Retainer is a metered data feed on Hedera testnet, gated with x402 and settled through the Blocky402 facilitator.

What makes it different from an ordinary x402 resource: the ordinary pattern charges on **every** request — 402, sign, retry, pay, repeat. Retainer charges once. That single payment is forwarded on-chain into the RetainerAccess contract (0.0.10415845), which opens a subscription and arms a scheduled call through HIP-1215, the Hedera schedule system contract at 0x16b. When the access window closes, the network itself calls `renew()` on the contract. No user, no cron, no second signature.

So an agent's flow is:

1. `GET /api/retainer/access?agent=<evm address>` with no subscription → **402** with an x402 challenge.
2. Pay it once (scheme `exact`, network `hedera:testnet`, native HBAR). Retry with the `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header → **200**, and the subscription is opened on-chain.
3. Call again inside the window → **200** with `paidThisRequest: false`. Nothing is signed and nothing is charged.
4. Call again *after* the window would have expired → still **200**, because the contract renewed itself.

`/api/retainer/status` is a free, unauthenticated chain read for polling that state without touching the payment path.

get.description:
Returns the resource when the agent holds an open on-chain subscription, and a 402 x402 challenge when it does not.

The agent pays **once**. After that, calls inside the window return 200 with `paidThisRequest: false`, and calls after the window would have expired also return 200 — the Hedera Schedule Service renewed it with nobody awake.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: The agent's EVM address. This is the identity the subscription is held against.

200.description: Access granted. Either the subscription was already open, or it was opened by the payment on this request.

402.description: Payment required. The body is a standard x402 challenge and is emitted verbatim in the `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header, so an ordinary x402 client can parse either.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: The same challenge, base64 for x402 clients.

400.description: `agent` was missing or is not an EVM address. Nothing was read from the chain.

429.description: The metered quota for this period is exhausted. It resets when the window renews.

502.description: An upstream read or the payment facilitator was unavailable.

503.description: RetainerAccess is not deployed on the target network.

get.summary: Read the subscription state from the chain
get.description: A free, side-effect-free chain read. Every number here comes from the contract, not from a database — there is no database. Safe to poll; it never touches the payment path and never returns 402.

200.description: The subscription as the contract currently sees it.

400.description: `agent` was missing or malformed. The chain was not read.

503.description: RetainerAccess is not deployed on the target network.

paidThisRequest.description: False whenever the open window served the call. This is the point of the product.

why.description: Plain-language reason the call was served.

metering.description: Usage is counted on-chain. The renewal that extends the window also refills this.

recordedOnChain.description: Transaction hash of the on-chain usage record.

expiresAt.description: Unix seconds at which the window closes.

balanceTinybar.description: Refundable balance, in tinybar (1 HBAR = 1e8 tinybar). A string because it exceeds a safe integer.

nextRenewalSchedule.description: Address of the pending scheduled call. The zero address means no renewal is armed.

contract.description: The RetainerAccess contract this answer was read from.

hasAccess.description: The gate's own question, answered from the state the contract uses.

periodsFunded.description: How many more times this subscription can renew before the money runs out.

nextRenewalSchedule.description: Non-zero means the network is holding a renewal for this agent.

renewalsReserveCanArm.description: How many further renewals the seller's gas reserve can arm, for anyone. Null when that read did not answer.

usage.description: Metered usage this period. The renewal resets it. Null when that read did not answer.

unavailable.description: Auxiliary reads the chain did not answer on this poll. The window above is unaffected.

now.description: Server time in unix seconds, so a caller can check the arithmetic.

PaymentRequired.description: A standard x402 challenge. Scheme `exact`, network `hedera:testnet`, native HBAR, settled through the Blocky402 facilitator.

amount.description: Amount in tinybar for the whole purchase.
